scope.summary: Support alternate layouts: multiple named page-size/orientation variants coexisting inside one StudioDocument, displayed side by side in the page-navigation surface, with stories linked (MT-153 linked stories) back to the source layout so edits can propagate. Provide a flex/container layout mode (container-based responsive layout with direction, wrap, alignment, and spacing properties) with conflict reporting against fixed positioning. Backed by StudioPageSpread variants + StudioLayoutGrid/StudioAutoLayout (LayoutEngine); no forked layout model.
acceptance_criteria: named alternate layouts coexist with linked-story propagation; flex/container mode with conflict reporting
proof_targets: alternate-layout coexistence + propagation; flex conflict-report test
expected_tests: live: two named layout variants coexist side by side; edit to source propagates via linked stories
test: flex/container layout applies direction/wrap/align/spacing and reports conflicts vs fixed positioning

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Alternate & container layouts

risk_if_missed: Cannot ship multi-size/device variants from one document; responsive container layout unavailable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
